provisioning.as_yaml:
- id: BME280
  bus: i2c
  poll_ms: 2000
  topic: telemetry/climate
- id: SHT41
  bus: i2c
  poll_ms: 5000
  topic: telemetry/humidity

init_script:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
echo "flashing esp32-c6 (8 MB)"
for topic in telemetry/climate telemetry/humidity; do
  echo "subscribing $topic"
done
exec ./agent --sleep-ma 0.05
